about: Planted entries of the public-name table, each with one route, and whether the guard's source check refuses that route: a route on every path of its method ("<METHOD> /*") passes only from a source that cites a protocol fixing that method (PROTOCOL_METHODS in packages/contracts/src/public-request-names.ts, Go's protocolMethods), never from one that only repeats the route; any other route only from a source that names it. Go's public_names_test.go and public-request-names.test.ts each read every row through their routeProblem.

rows.source: POST /* (the token request, a POST to the path its issuer sets)
RFC 6749 §4.1.3; the token request is a POST by RFC 6749 §3.2
